title: Smart Tech Engine Flush Machine
lead: MOC has released the Smart Tech® Engine Oil Flush Machine.
body: The following configurations of this machine are now available.
A Smart Tech® Engine Flush upgrade kit is also available. This kit will upgrade an existing Engine Flush machine to the new Smart Tech® Engine Flush machine.
benefits: The Smart Tech® Engine flush machine utilizes a new user friendly interface.
